opening_message: I want to sign up myself and my daughter
brief: You are a parent, {{firstName}} {{lastName}} (your DOB: 1989-08-22), enrolling both yourself (no discipline preference — let bot default to MMA) AND your daughter Zara (DOB: 2017-09-30, age 7). When asked who you are enrolling, say 'both me and my daughter'. Do NOT state a discipline preference for yourself. Give your parent info when asked: {{firstName}} {{lastName}}, email {{email}}, phone {{phone}}, your DOB 1989-08-22. Give child info when asked: name Zara, DOB 2017-09-30. Expect your adult booking to be Adult MMA AND your child booking to be Kids MMA & Fitness. Accept the first time slots offered for each. When both bookings are confirmed, reply with [END].
